backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ProFi Mine backend, defining data types for mining projects, user profiles, and subscription tiers, along with state maps and helper functions for project management, user profile resets, and access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two tracked features: removing PDF export from the Export tab and fixing the failing Save project action, with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering components, hooks, contexts, utilities, and pages in the ProFi Mine React application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ProFi Mine frontend, mounting the React app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for login, dashboard, payment success, and payment failure pages under a shared RootComponent layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and clearing React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to enter their name, email, organization, and choose between Free or Premium subscription tiers, then saves the profile via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/charts/CostBreak: Pie chart component that visualizes the breakdown of mining, processing, G&A, royalties, and closure costs from project calculations, with a chart-only export button using useChartExport.
frontend/src/components/charts/Cumulativ: Renders a line chart of cumulative free cash flow over project years using Recharts, with a download button that exports only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/charts/Productio: Renders a bar chart of annual recovered metal production (in kg) using Recharts, with an export button that saves only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/common/InfoToolt: A small reusable tooltip component that displays a help icon and shows explanatory text on hover using Radix UI Tooltip primitives.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Sticky top navigation header displaying the app logo, current project name, subscription usage stats, and buttons for saving, loading, and authentication.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportTab: Export tab UI that allows users to download financial projections as a CSV file, with usage limit enforcement and warnings for free-tier users.
frontend/src/components/guide/Glossary.t: Searchable accordion glossary component that filters and displays term definitions from a constants file based on user input.
frontend/src/components/guide/UsageGuide: Usage guide tab with a sticky table of contents sidebar and a main content area rendering guide sections and the Glossary component from constants.
frontend/src/components/inputs/CostStruc: Form section for entering mine cost structure inputs (CAPEX, OPEX, royalties, etc.) with labeled fields, tooltips, and dynamic year-based configuration.
frontend/src/components/inputs/DynamicAr: Reusable input component for managing a dynamic list of per-year numeric values, with add/remove year buttons and individual labeled inputs.
frontend/src/components/inputs/EconomicP: Renders a form section for economic parameters (inflation rate, discount rate, tax rate, and commodity price forecast) using inputs bound to the ProjectContext.
frontend/src/components/inputs/Financing: Renders a form section for financing inputs (equity ratio and interest rate) bound to the ProjectContext.
frontend/src/components/inputs/InputsTab: Composes all input sections (reserves/production, economic parameters, cost structure, financing) into a single tabbed card for project data entry.
frontend/src/components/inputs/ReservesP: Renders a form section for reserves and production inputs (ore reserves, grade, recovery rate, stripping ratio, and annual ROM tonnage schedule) bound to the ProjectContext.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the root app layout with a ThemeProvider, an Outlet for nested routes, a Toaster, and a footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/layout/RootCompo: Root component that renders AppLayout and conditionally shows a ProfileSetupModal when an authenticated user has no profile yet.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentF: Displays a payment failure screen with common failure reasons and buttons to retry (navigate to dashboard) or contact support.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentS: Displays a payment success screen, invalidates the user profile query to refresh subscription status, and provides a button to navigate to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/project/ProjectL: Modal dialog that lists saved projects with options to load or delete each one, using project queries and the ProjectContext.
frontend/src/components/project/SaveProj: Modal dialog for saving a project by name, enforcing subscription usage limits and showing an upgrade prompt when the limit is reached.
frontend/src/components/projections/Cash: Renders a scrollable table showing yearly cash flow data including Operating Cash Flow, CAPEX, Closure Costs, Free Cash Flow, and Cumulative FCF, with color-coded positive/negative values.
frontend/src/components/projections/Inco: Renders a scrollable yearly income statement table displaying Revenue, OPEX, Royalties, EBITDA, Taxes, and Net Income pulled from project calculations context.
frontend/src/components/projections/Proj: Composes the full Projections tab layout, combining Summary KPIs, cumulative cash flow and production charts, a cost breakdown pie chart, and income/cash flow statement tables inside cards.
frontend/src/components/projections/Summ: Displays a simple two-column table of key financial KPIs (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM, Average EBITDA, Payback Period) with green highlighting for positive values.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Scen: Shows a comparison table of NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM across base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios, with edit buttons that open a ScenarioEditor dialog for each scenario.
A dialog component that allows editing percentage adjustments for commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, and OPEX for a given scenario (base, optimistic, or pessimistic).
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Sens: Provides sliders to interactively adjust five key variables (±20%) and displays the resulting adjusted NPV, IRR, and ROI compared to base values.
Composes the Sensitivity tab layout, combining the SensitivityControls and SensitivityTornado components in one card and the ScenarioComparison in a second card.

Renders a horizontal bar chart (tornado chart) showing the impact of ±20% variation in key variables on NPV, using data from SensitivityContext. Displays a placeholder message if no tornado data is available.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Sub: A dialog modal that displays the user's current subscription tier and usage, and allows upgrading to Premium by initiating a Stripe checkout session. Handles checkout session creation and redirects to Stripe on success.
frontend/src/config/stripe.ts: Exports the Stripe publishable key as a constant for use in frontend Stripe integrations.
frontend/src/constants/glossary.ts: Exports a dictionary mapping mining and financial terminology keys to their plain-English definitions for use in tooltips or help text throughout the app.
frontend/src/constants/guideContent.ts: Exports structured guide content with sections covering application overview, getting started steps, input parameter explanations, and financial calculation formulas for the in-app user guide.
frontend/src/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx: Provides a React context managing project inputs, financial calculations, project save/load operations, and subscription tier/usage data derived from the user's profile. Recalculates financials whenever inputs change.
frontend/src/contexts/ScenarioContext.ts: Provides a React context that computes and stores financial results (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM) for base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios by applying percentage adjustments to project inputs. Wraps children with SensitivityProvider.
frontend/src/contexts/SensitivityContext: Provides a React context for sensitivity analysis, computing adjusted financial results (NPV, IRR, ROI) based on user-defined percentage adjustments to key inputs, and generating tornado chart data with ±20% swings on each variable.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChartExport.ts: Custom hook that exports a Recharts SVG chart to a PNG file by cloning the SVG, inlining computed styles, rendering to a 2x-resolution canvas, and triggering a browser download.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Custom hook that exposes a React Query mutation to call the backend's createCheckoutSession method with shopping items and return/cancel URLs, parsing the JSON response into a Stripe checkout session object.
frontend/src/hooks/useExcelExport.ts: Custom hook that generates a CSV export of the current project's financial model (summary KPIs, assumptions, production schedule, income statement) after verifying and decrementing the user's export quota via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login status, identity persistence across page reloads, and exposing login/clear functions through a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfExport.ts: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, mining projects, Stripe configuration, and subscription tier info via an actor interface.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system using OKLCH color values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page with five tabs (Inputs, Projections, Sensitivity, Export, Guide) wrapped in ProjectProvider and ScenarioProvider, redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page displaying the app branding, a LoginButton for Internet Identity authentication, and a feature list; redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/types/external.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file reserved for external module type definitions.
frontend/src/utils/calculations.ts: Provides financial calculation logic for mining projects, including yearly cash flow modeling, NPV, IRR, ROI, and payback period computations based on project input parameters.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting numbers as currency, percentages, locale-formatted numbers, and dates from bigint timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, accordion animations, and enabling the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the ProFi Mine financial modeling app project, including versioning, known issues (failing Models Save action, duplicate Equity Ratio/Interest Rate fields), existing features, and a pending fix request for the duplicate Inputs dashboard fields.
